{{Quote|There must be ''some'' amusement I can offer you. Perhaps blossom wine from ''Naboo''... along with ''another'' of that world's treasures?|Jib Kopatha, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Empire 19">[[Empire 19|''Empire'' 19]]</ref>}}
An '''unidentified Naboo female''' lived on [[Void Station]], working as a servant for a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] named [[Jib Kopatha]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] arrived to Void Station, planning to extract information from Kopatha. After subjecting the Bothan to a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|force choke]] and quickly overpowering his bodyguards, Vader made it clear that he expected better results. Kopatha tried curry favor with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] by offering him various off-world "delicacies", such as food, beverages and women.

Among them was a young and pretty [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] female, offering Vader [[blossom wine]]. He stared at her for a few seconds, which prompted the young woman to ask him if something was wrong. Vader bluntly answered "no" and quickly turned away, as the woman presumably reminded him of his late wife, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].
